title: Select existing material writer and bounded household state ABI

classification_detail.detail: Same-branch household/parent-choice schemas and P2Owner.material_fact key set are unchanged. A verified C12 fork may now carry a fact established on an ancestor; read branch is current, document branch remains provenance.
New module-level branch_is_ancestor and optional fork-only state_scope field (C12_FORK_WITHOUT_S46_INTERVAL_STATE). No new owner, scheduler, ledger, clock or database.
p2_owner.py byte change alters P3Owner._code_pins()/config_hash. A-era roots created at edbb4b344 and all pre-B01 roots refuse cold reopen with P3_CONFIG_CHANGED. No migration invented.
house.py imports p2_owner.branch_is_ancestor. A mixed cut with B house.py and A p2_owner.py fails at import. Pair3 C01 must rebase/reconcile both files together.
The fork proof is an in-process verified-owner read/action; full P6 cold fork reopen remains blocked by P2 owner/P3 branch binding outside this lease.

summary: Preserved A's existing S47/P2 checkpoint writer and bounded p6_household ABI, established the C12 fork defect on A's exact HEAD, and repaired the actual P2/P6 readers to follow a verified ancestor branch without rebinding source or creating a new owner. Same-branch reads are unchanged; fork reads are pure and preserve source while the bound material hash changes.

fork_semantics.stored_branch: establishment provenance; retained in the stored p6_household/p6_house documents
fork_semantics.read_branch: current C12 branch; returned by readers
fork_semantics.source: content/schema hash excluding root, branch, epoch, source; stable across fork
fork_semantics.material_hash: bound current-state hash including root, current branch, clock, epoch, source, place, owner, resolved resources; changes on fork even when resolved values are equal
fork_semantics.acceptance: current branch or verified C12 ancestor with lineage, copied-prefix/shared-root verification, acyclic parent chain, and epoch <= fork_clock at every copied edge
fork_semantics.refusal: sibling/foreign branch, malformed row, missing store, invalid epoch, or fact established after fork
fork_semantics.read_purity: no episode, checkpoint, world event, perception, owner, scheduler or branch write
